description: What kind of thing one agent handed to the next — the coarse label a handoff surface paints beside an item so a reader can tell a shared instruction from a dropped tool. The vocabulary is deliberately small and transport-neutral: a host maps its own payload (a system prompt, a tool catalogue, a file, a scratchpad) onto one of these five kinds, and the surface renders the kind as a localized word plus an icon. Context is the default because a piece of conversation is the most common thing a handoff carries.
usageExample: var item = new HandoffItem("the buyer's deadline", HandoffItemKind.Memory);
